projects.name: Aerosub Solutions inspection platform
bullets: Built and maintained features across a multi-tenant SaaS inspection platform using Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript with nested dynamic routing.
Developed interactive 2D/3D and 360-degree panorama viewers with defect positioning using Three.js and Canvas-based rendering.
Integrated REST APIs throughout the application using Axios, handling authentication, query scoping, error states, and silent token refresh.
Implemented file upload pipelines using presigned S3 URLs with concurrent workers, real-time progress tracking, and drag-and-drop support.
Managed client state using Zustand across multiple feature domains and built report generation workflows with PDF and XLSX export.

projects.name: nestFind
projects.role: Personal project — full-stack real estate platform
bullets: Built a full-stack real estate listing platform using Next.js, Express, and MongoDB with JWT-based authentication and role-based access control (user/moderator/admin).
Implemented real-time buyer-seller messaging with Socket.IO, including per-conversation unread tracking and room-based delivery.
Designed a listing verification workflow with moderator review, plus rate-limited auth endpoints and Cloudinary-backed image uploads.
Wrote an integration test suite (Vitest, Supertest, mongodb-memory-server) and deployed the app across Render and Vercel.

projects.name: Sheila MERN Stack Web App
bullets: Built a full-stack MERN app with a RESTful API (Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose), implementing CRUD operations connected to React frontend components.
Integrated Redis caching with Upstash and deployed on Render, maintaining a clean client-server architecture using environment variables.

known_gaps: No production Kubernetes or container-orchestration experience — Docker exposure is tooling-level (used it as a listed tool), not production deployment/orchestration
